prompt: Unknown C₃H₆O. IR: strong C=O at ~1715 cm⁻¹, NO broad O-H, NO aldehyde doublet at 2720/2820. MS: M⁺ = 58, base peak at m/z = 43. Identify.

options.label: Allyl alcohol (would show broad O-H, no C=O)

explanation: C=O at 1715 narrows to carbonyl. No aldehyde doublet (2720/2820) rules out propanal. No broad O-H rules out allyl alcohol. M⁺=58 fits C₃H₆O. m/z=43 is loss of methyl (M-15), giving the acetyl cation (CH₃C≡O⁺). All consistent with acetone.
